title: Sheikh Shakhbout Medical City launches integrated multidisciplinary Lupus Clinic
excerpt: Source: Abu Dhabi Media Office Sheikh Shakhbout Medical City (SSMC), a flagship hospital in the UAE for serious and complex care and a subsidiary of PureHealth, has launched an integrated multidisciplinary Lupus Clinic, introducing a coordinated, patient-centred model of care designed to simplify and enhance the treatment journey for individuals living with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). […] The post Sheikh Shakhbout Medical City launches integrated multidisciplinary Lupus Clinic appeared first on PureHealth .
